mapper.select: SELECT status FROM notification_sms_delivery WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND provider_id = #{providerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_sms_delivery (id, message_id, provider_id, route, recipient_hash, recipient_masked, status) VALUES (#{deliveryId}, #{messageId}, #{providerId}, #{route}, #{recipientHash}, #{recipientMasked}, 'PENDING') ON CONFLICT (message_id, provider_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_sms_delivery SET status = #{status}, request_id = #{requestId}, biz_id = #{bizId}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND provider_id = #{providerId} AND status = 'PENDING'
